out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The person in charge cannot locate employee health policy for the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. The EHS left the person in charge several employee forms. The person to charge will have the employees read and sign the forms.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The person in charge cannot locate the vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedures for the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS provided the person in charge with a copy of the model Fairfax County, health department, vomit and diarrhea, cleanup procedures which he will adopt.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels at the handwashing sink next to the dishwasher.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The person in charge corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap provided at the handwashing sink next to the dishwasher.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The person in charge corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the bar is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. A wheeled cart is permanently placed in front of the sink and the sink is not being used.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. The food employee moved the cart during the inspection to correct. Discontinue storing the cart in front of the handsink.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken was being stored over several, ready to eat food in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The person in charge move the raw chicken during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw chicken was being stored over raw beef in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). The person in charge move the raw chicken into a lower shelf during the inspection to correct

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: large, 5 gallon buckets of beans and other dried food/ingredients store underneath one of the prep tables were not covered. Several foods in the refrigerator were not covered.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. All foods must be covered while in storage, unless they are being cooled. The EHS discussed this with the person in charge who said he will cover all the items.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: A container previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials (dishwashing soap) is being used to store flour.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store food in containers previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials. This practice may result in food contamination and subsequent medical consequences to anyone consuming the contaminated food. The PIC discarded the flour and the chemical bucket during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A bottle of gorilla glue was stored over plates in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The person in charge discarded the glue during the inspection to correct NAZRET RESTAURANT AND BAKERY (Inspection Date: 10/26/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped insects and rodents were found on the premises. There were at least two dead mice on glue boards in the attic space as well as several dead insects in this area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. Remove the dead insects and mice as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months. NAZRET RESTAURANT AND BAKERY (Inspection Date: 10/26/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: several in use utensils including spoons, ladles, and knives were being stored in room temperature (75º) standing water on the prep table in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The person charged corrected this by taking all the equipment to the three compartment sink and cleaning them.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Clean utensils were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward in the storage containers behind the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. The person in charge had one of the food employees correct us during the inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of several foods. Manufacturer candy containers and others were being re-used to stored foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. The EHS advised the PIC that reuse manufacturer containers is not permitted. Discontinue reusing manufacturer containers. Replace with approved food- grade containers as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Single-service items (rectangular aluminum pans) were observed reused for the storage of spices and herbs and other food products.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items may not be reused. Aluminum pans are a single use item and may not be reused. After a single use, they must be discarded. They cannot be washed and reused. These pans are not easily cleanable and it’s not possible to completely clean and sanitize them. Discontinue reusing aluminum pans. The EHS pulled all the aluminum pans that appeared to have been reused from the shelving in the kitchen and advised the person in charge to discard them and discontinue this practice.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the two door prep refrigerator has a significant amount of water on the bottom of the inside of it and was obviously leaking. There is an active leak on the refrigeration unit in the walk-in. The leaking fluid is being captured by a plastic pan on the top shelf of the shelving unit.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Have the unit serviced to discover and correct the cause of the leak. Clean out the water. Repair the leaking walk-in unit. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that toilet room doors are being kept open. The doors on the men’s and women’s toilet rooms were propped open and they were not provided with self- closing devices.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. Keep the toilet room doors closed at all times. Install self-closers on both doors so they self-close. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency

Clean the floors, especially under all equipment and tables and all soiled walls as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair the hole in the wall as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed 6 months.

violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT. NAZRET RESTAURANT AND BAKERY (Inspection Date: 03/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw meat stored over cooked food in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REARRANGED WALK IN COOLER

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: regular platter, meat combo
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: A container previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials is being used to store food. OBSERVED FOOD STORED IN SOAP BUCKETS IN THE WALK IN COOLER. SOME BUCKETS WERE LINED WITH BAGS AND OTHERS WERE NOT.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store food in containers previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials. This practice may result in food contamination and subsequent medical consequences to anyone consuming the contaminated food. PIC BEGAN REMOVING FOOD IN BAGS FROM SOAP BUCKETS AND DISCARDING FOOD NOT IN BAGS. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP TO ENSURE ALL SOAP BUCKETS HAVE BEEN REMOVED.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed frozen fish being thawed on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC PLACED THE FISH IN THE REFRIGERATOR.
